c74object.name: evi.4wave~
c74object.digest: Anti-aliased Saw, Rect, Tri and Sine simultaneous oscillators
c74object.description:
evi.4wave~ is a 'max define' for the evi_4wave.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.4wave~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
Phase synchronous shared frequency oscillators with simultaneous Saw, Rect, Tri and Sine outputs. Anti-aliasing method is 4-point polyblep.

inlet.description: Reset is naive and not anti-aliased.

outlet.description: Anti-aliased Saw oscillator in sync with other outputs
Anti-aliased Rect oscillator in sync with other outputs
Anti-aliased Tri oscillator in sync with other outputs
Anti-aliased Sine oscillator in sync with other outputs, the sine is not pure and has an additional harmonic.
Phase of oscillators for synchronising processes downstream.

attribute.name: zerosync
attribute.description: If on, tri phase is aligned at zero crossings with the other three oscillators. If off (slightly cheaper) tri phase is at the peak of the tri shape.
